observations.finding: Living/capture/block eligibility differs; team aggregate and StartTouch guard handle contested and repeated-entry cases. Mode flags alter behavior.
Contested is distinct from unattended recede; explicit deadlines feed presentation.
Periodic validity/range/LOS checks and actual-accepted metal deduction avoid stale recipients and over-grants.
State-derived locked/owner overlays and managed status display are inspectable; accessibility and aesthetic quality need actual review.
Decompiler/config/editor capabilities and licenses are distinct; none supplies general Valve art rights or a complete Godot game.

recommendations.decision: Original fixed-tick relay state, explicit eligible entity set and vertical band, one capture result per tick; YUGA-authored tuning.

recommendations.status: design recommendation; receiving runtime API must exist
recommendations.decision: Bounded uncontested owner supply with LOS/height/team/cooldown checks, actual accepted receipts; no hero healing claim without hero health.

recommendations.status: design inference, not a finding from the blocked rendering paper
recommendations.decision: Original relay/supply glyphs and troop-attack marker hierarchy; verify day/night/overlap and text at960x600 and1280x720.
Retain Godot/Blender and original assets; no Source SDK code port or commercial asset adoption; no tools installed this pass.

limits: The official TF2 art paper and Valve publications page were blocked by proxy403; no paper content read.
The one ordinary Reddit request returned403HTML; no new post/comment corpus or player-consensus claim.
Reading is limited to recorded ranges; complete Source/TF2 implementation and runtime behavior not audited.
TrenchBroom documentation/implementation drift about Quake3 patches was recorded, not resolved through execution.
Gameplay designs and initial art motifs are YUGA proposals, not code ports or measured balance/accessibility results.
No leaked source was fetched or adopted.
scratch_retention: Raw downloaded source remains under /workspace/scratch/yuga-tf2-study; the repository stores metadata, bounded excerpts and analysis only.
